svg.title: Six roles, a floor each, placed by measurement
svg.text: Each role went to the cheapest arm that cleared its floor, or back to a rule.
a name table; the live lane as fallback
rules decide; a model may explain beside
27 of 30 at 12.7 s on the live lane
the verifier: a pair of probes
216 labeled items, 15 arms, three calls per item with the majority taken; a floor written before any run
